nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Same inputs as the former agent-spine When Called trigger.

nodes.name: Call PD Verifier
nodes.notes: Simplified: no $if($isExecuted) guard needed — SW3 always has When Called as its only trigger.

nodes.name: Call Decide Research
nodes.notes: Calls Decide Research and Deliver (v1). Returns { web_findings, web_sources }. continueRegularOutput so a research failure doesn't abort context assembly.

nodes.name: Load Agent Rules
nodes.notes: Fetches AI doc pages (q7wz-16892) as markdown. onError=continueRegularOutput -> run proceeds degraded (Build Prompt flags global_rules_missing -> WARN).

nodes.name: Build Prompt
nodes.notes: Assembles full prompt from context gather + workspace search + research + rules. web_sources serialized to JSON string for safe passage through executeWorkflow.

nodes.name: Check Rules Loaded
nodes.notes: Side branch: WARN if agent rules or personal prefs failed to load.

value.message: Brak zasad agenta przy budowie promptu (globalnych i/lub osobistych).

nodes.name: Return Context
nodes.notes: Single guaranteed terminal node for this subworkflow. All branches (rules-ok, rules-missing+alert) converge here. Always returns Build Prompt output.
